probe: DOM.setFileInputFiles([<dir>]) on a webkitdirectory input whose chooser was intercepted
hypothesis: On Chromium 155.0.8059.84 --headless=new, DOM.setFileInputFiles([<dir>]) on a webkitdirectory input whose chooser was intercepted answers within 5 s and the page receives input+change with one File per regular file under <dir>, each with a non-empty webkitRelativePath. Alternative: the command does not answer (L1 throwaway exploration saw no answer in ~60 s) or the page gets nothing.

method.fixture: loopback 127.0.0.1 HTTP, one page, <input type=file id=s> + <input type=file id=d webkitdirectory>, window capture-phase listeners record every pointer/mouse/click/input/change/cancel with isTrusted, userActivation and full file snapshot {name,size,type,webkitRelativePath}
method.flow: Page.enable + Runtime.enable + Page.setInterceptFileChooserDialog{enabled:true} -> navigate -> real mouse click (Input.dispatchMouseEvent mousePressed+mouseReleased) on the target input -> wait Page.fileChooserOpened -> DOM.setFileInputFiles{files:[<3-file dir, one nested>], backendNodeId:<event's>} with a 20 s per-command budget -> watch the page up to 12 s for input/change, then read final input.files
method.dirUnderTest: 3 regular files: a-first.txt (6 B), b-two.bin (5 B), sub/three-deep.txt (7 B, nested one level)
method.script: probe-dir-setfiles-r77.mjs (copy beside this receipt; scratch original removed with the scratch dir)

runs.variant: nondir (control: same directory path to the plain single-file input #s)
runs.reading: no enumeration: the directory itself becomes a single File entry with empty webkitRelativePath, empty type and the directory inode's stat size (53 B); matches file_input_type.cc:545-554 (non-directory branch takes each path as a FileChooserFileInfoNative)

mechanism: DOM.setFileInputFiles -> HTMLInputElement::SetFilesFromPaths (S210 inspector_dom_agent.cc:1795-1816); webkitdirectory input routes paths[0] to FileInputType::SetFilesFromDirectory (S210 file_input_type.cc:540-542) which builds a kUploadFolder chooser with selected_files=[dir] and calls EnumerateChosenDirectory (525-532); interception only suppresses the chooser UI and emits Page.fileChooserOpened (S211 inspector_page_agent.cc:1899-1912, setInterceptFileChooserDialog 1949-1956). The enumeration answers synchronously from the pre-selected folder; no second fileChooserOpened was ever observed.
extraObservations: chooser event 0-4 ms after the mouseReleased send; input/change 152-159 ms after the set by watch sampling (page timestamps put input ~33 ms after click)
input+change are trusted engine-dispatched events but navigator.userActivation.isActive is already false at input/change time although the trigger click carried transient activation
input.value on the directory input becomes the fakepath of the first enumerated file (C:\fakepath\a-first.txt)
the L1's ~60 s no-answer was not reproduced in 3/3 runs (0-4 ms answers)
